All On 6 in Turkey (All On Six in Turkey)

The all-on-six in Turkey achieves successful results by combining expert staff, modern technology, quality materials and affordable price advantages. Dentaliva Dental Clinic offers a reliable choice as an address that stands out with the quality service it offers in this field. The all-on-six implant is a type of dental implant that replaces the entire dental arch. Instead of making individual implants like classical implant types, they are fixed to the jawbone with six implant screws. What makes All on Six implant treatment different from classical implant treatments is not the number of implants, but the feature of the implant-supported prosthesis. The implant-supported prosthesis is placed on the implants by screwing them with spacers called multiunit.
What is the All On Six Implant Technique?

The all-on-six implant technique is performed much faster than classical dental implants. In classical implant treatments, there is a 3-month waiting period after the implant is placed in the jawbone. In the all-on-six implant technique, temporary fixed teeth are placed on the implants as soon as they are placed.

In the all-on-six implant treatment, a titanium screw is placed into the jawbone. Titanium screws are positioned at almost equal distances. Thus, they offer the strength that the jaw needs. Crown parts are produced from porcelain or zirconium.

All-on-six implant is a type of implant-supported dentures. While in classical treatments one implant is planned for each missing tooth, in this technique six implants are applied per jaw. The all-on-six implant technique is based on getting maximum efficiency from the prosthesis by providing extra support.
Who Can Have All-On-Six Implants?

The all on six implant technique is for those who want to have an entire dental arch implanted. It is a more cost-effective solution to replace the missing natural teeth. It offers a better appearance compared to denture teeth. They are also more comfortable due to their extra functionality.

The six implants used in the all-on-six implant technique give extra strength to the jaw. Bone loss that may occur due to missing teeth can be prevented. They are much more reliable for those looking for a long-term solution. The difference with all-on-four is that it gives extra strength to the jaw structure.

The situation of each person who wants to have an implant is different. If you want to have an all-on-six implant, your oral health and general health must be in good condition. Your dentist decides whether you are suitable for treatment by looking at images such as three-dimensional tomography.
Is it risky to have an All-on-six Implant in Turkey?

All-on-six implant treatment in Turkey has surgical procedures. This treatment has absolutely no risks depending on the country. However, each surgical procedure has its own specific risks. These risks do not originate from the country where the treatment is performed. There are possible risks after every surgical procedure. These risks are generally very low and the number of patients experiencing complications is very low. These lower risks are as follows:

Infection: If you ignore your dentist’s recommendations after treatment, you run the risk of infection. Infection causes implant treatment to fail. For this reason, you should follow your dentist’s recommendations.
Nerve Damage: If your dentist damages the nerves while placing the implant, you will experience some negative effects. If the nerves in the jaw are damaged, your lips and cheeks may become numb.

Sinus Complication: The sinus cavity, which is an anatomical space, is important for implant treatments. In patients who remain toothless for a long time, the sinus cavity sags downwards and causes bone resorption. This complication may also occur during All-on-six implant treatment.

In general, the success rate of implant treatments is very high. If your dentist is experienced, you will not have any problems. However, if you see an inexperienced dentist to reduce the cost of treatment, you may face the risk of complications.
What are the Advantages of All-On Six Implant?

All-on-six implants do not cause problems such as slipping in the mouth. This problem, which is frequently experienced with dentures, can negatively affect your quality of life. You will not experience any problems such as slipping after the implants are placed right in the jaw arch.

This type of implant is a fast technique. Immediately after the implants are placed, fixed temporary prostheses are made on the implants and no teeth are left during the fusing of the implants with the bone. “Implant in one day” treatment concepts offer a very comfortable experience.

The most important aspect of the all-on-six implant technique is that it requires a small number of implants. The number is significantly reduced, especially when compared to implant-supported prostheses. Naturally, the recovery period after treatment progresses much faster.

Since the all-on-six implant provides extra strength to the jawbone, your ability to chew and speak is positively affected. You can protect your oral health thanks to implants that function just like natural teeth. At the same time, you can improve your general appearance.

In addition to all these advantages, all-on-six treatment in Turkey also has special advantages. All-on-six in Turkey is applied by experienced specialist dentists. In recent years, Turkey is one of the countries that offers the most advanced methods and techniques in medicine, plastic surgery and dental treatments at the most affordable prices. Since it is a touristic country, you can have an all-on-six treatment even during your holiday.
What is the Cost of All-On-Six Implant in Turkey?

Prices of all-on-six implant in Turkey vary. It is necessary to consider different criteria such as the current condition of the patient, the procedures to be performed before the implant, the time to be allocated to the treatment and post-treatment care. In general, it is more cost-effective than classical implant treatment. Getting an all-on-six implant instead of an implant-supported prosthesis can save you money. No matter what, you should remember that you will need to allocate a certain budget for the treatment.

Contrary to what is believed, smile makeover, which provides advantages not only in aesthetic improvement but also in supporting oral and dental health, is a comprehensive application containing more than one treatment method. Especially smile makeover in istanbul Turkey can be performed in reliable clinics like Dentaliva in a way that will provide advantages to the individual in terms of aesthetics, economics, and health.
What is Smile Makeover?

Smile makeover is a comprehensive application performed in terms of individuals being able to attain their ideal smile appearance. The smile makeover application, which can be performed by benefiting from more than one treatment method, can be completed with success in the direction of custom plannings for the patient. Especially in professional healthcare institutions like Dentaliva where top rated smile makeover dentists in Turkey take place, smile makeover is planned towards the individual attaining both an aesthetic and healthy smile appearance in the long term and is performed with reliable methods.
Treatments Falling Into the Scope of Smile Makeover

There are many different treatments falling into the scope of smile makeover. A dentist for smile makeover, instead of benefiting from standard treatment methods and plans while making a planning, creates a treatment plan by combining more than one treatment method, taking factors such as the individual’s general oral health and aesthetic demands into consideration. The treatment methods that can fall into the scope of this planning, that is the smile makeover application, can be explained under several headings.
Implant Treatment

Suprisingly implant treatments are one of the primary treatment methods falling into the scope of smile makeover. This is primarily because implant treatments are performed with the aim of eliminating tooth losses.

Tooth losses damage the general oral and dental health of individuals and can disrupt the aesthetic appearance to a great extent in the long term. Because of this, when an individual who has experienced tooth loss consults a dentist to have a smile makeover done, the dentist smile makeover primarily prefers to eliminate tooth losses with implant treatment within the scope of smile makeover. In this way, the individual both eliminates the current tooth loss, takes precautions against problems such as the alignment of their other teeth being disrupted, and can protect the jawbone density.
Tooth Whitening

Tooth whitening, or bleaching with its other known name, is one of the most preferred treatment methods in smile makeover applications in many parts of the world and in Turkey. Tooth whitening applications are generally performed in a clinical environment by using special whitening gels and medical devices. However, in some situations, home-type tooth whitening can also be done under the control of the dentist. With the tooth whitening application, it becomes possible to attain a pearly white tooth appearance, which is one of the indispensable elements of an aesthetic smile appearance.
Tooth Veneer Applications

Tooth veneer applications are also among the most preferred treatment methods within the scope of smile makeover. In tooth veneer applications, depending on the situation, only the surfaces of the front teeth can be made aesthetic with quite thin-dimensional veneers, or defects in the tooth can be eliminated in a way that will provide advantages both in terms of health and in terms of aesthetics by making a veneer on a large part of the tooth. Especially veneer applications like Laminate Veneer, which offer results that are reliable, effective, and natural from an aesthetic point of view, come at the beginning of the treatment methods included in many smile makeover applications.
Gum Aesthetics

Gum aesthetics is also one of the popular smile makeover treatments. Especially for individuals who have a smile appearance named as gummy smile, that is, where the gums appear too much during the smile and cover a part of the teeth, it is recommended to perform gum aesthetics in smile makeover applications. Gum aesthetics is generally made by resorting to reliable medical methods with lasers in a way that aesthetic benefit will be provided without damaging the tooth and gum health of the individual.
Orthodontic Treatments

Another treatment type falling into the scope of smile makeover in many parts of the world and in Turkey is orthodontic treatments. Orthodontic treatments offer effective solutions against the tooth alignment problems of individuals. Especially alignment problems in the front teeth are a negative factor from an aesthetic point of view because they cause a crooked tooth appearance. Treatments like classic wire treatment or transparent plaque treatment coming into play at this point ensure that individuals attain an ideally aligned aesthetic smile appearance.
How is Smile Makeover Done?

Everything You Need to Know About Tooth Tartar

Tooth tartar, or calculus with its medical name, is one of the mouth problems that many people experience. Having information about tooth tartar and getting rid of tooth tartar with the most accurate medical interventions in the early period is much more important and necessary than many people assume. Let’s explore everything you need to know about tooth tartar and the important details regarding the subject.
What is Tooth Tartar?

Tooth tartar is the stony structure formed as a result of the bacterial plaques accumulating on the tooth surfaces hardening by interacting with the mineral in the content of the saliva. Plaques accumulating on the tooth surface can turn into tooth tartar within very short periods like 20 – 24 hours due to constant interaction with saliva. tooth tartar, which has both live and dead bacteria in its content, although it causes superficial problems like bad breath or the disruption of aesthetic appearance in the first stage, can put dental health and even general health status at risk in the long term.
Why Does Tooth Tartar Occur?

There are many different situations that can be listed among the reasons for the formation of tooth tartar. Important situations triggering the formation of tooth tartar can be categorized as follows:
Incorrect Oral Care Routines

Although many people think that tooth tartar forms only due to health problems, the situation is actually not like this. Oral care should be done in a quite delicate and regular way. Even though a large part of people sees oral and dental care as just consisting of brushing teeth, actually, the right oral and dental care routine must include both regular and correct tooth brushing and flossing. Individuals fulfilling their oral and dental care routines only by brushing their teeth in a superficial format can lead to the formation of tooth tartar as it causes plaques to remain.
Saliva Structure Containing Minerals at a High Rate

Tooth tartar forms as a result of plaques interacting with the minerals found in the saliva content. Because of this, individuals whose saliva structure is very rich in terms of minerals like calcium and phosphate are genetically more prone to tooth tartar formation. This proneness, especially when combined with factors triggering tooth tartar formation like applying incorrect oral care routines, can cause the individual to frequently face tooth tartar at certain intervals despite having a tooth tartar removal.
Having a Sugar-Heavy Diet

Having a sugar-heavy diet can indirectly lead to tooth tartar formation because it ensures the nourishment and rapid reproduction of bacteria in the mouth. Especially individuals who do not pay attention to teeth cleaning even though they constantly have a carbohydrate and sugar-heavy diet can frequently face tooth tartar.
Use of Tobacco Products

The use of tobacco products can also indirectly cause tooth tartar formation. Individuals using tobacco products like cigarettes witness their saliva secretions decreasing due to this use. The decrease of saliva secretion can cause a part of the saliva secretion, which has a protection and cleaning effect on the teeth albeit minimally, to be lost, and because of this, it can cause the plaque layers on the teeth to petrify.
Tooth Alignment Not Allowing Deep Teeth Cleaning

Tooth alignment not allowing deep teeth cleaning is one of the main situations causing tooth tartar formation. Many people whose teeth are aligned in a crooked way have difficulty on the subject of completely cleaning their tooth surfaces and between them due to this situation. Not being able to completely clean the tooth surfaces and between them can cause tooth tartar to form as it is triggering on the subject of bacteria reproduction and plaque accumulation.
How to Remove Tooth Tartar?
tartar tooth removal is an important medical intervention that must be performed by passing through a few steps. The stages of tartar tooth removal can be handled under several headings.
Comprehensive Examination

To remove tooth tartar, first of all, it is necessary to examine the patient comprehensively. This comprehensive examination, which helps to have information about the individual’s general oral health and the situations caused by the tooth tartar problem, helps an appropriate treatment planning to be made for the person by obtaining clear data about measurements like tooth tartar pocket depths, if any.
Breaking and Cleaning tooth tartar with Ultrasonic Devices

Breaking and cleaning tooth tartar with ultrasonic devices comes at the beginning of the main stages of tooth tartar removal. In order to get rid of tooth tartar in the healthiest way, it is necessary to break and shatter the tooth tartar with the ultrasonic vibration effect. The tooth tartar that is broken, shattered, and subsequently, the tartar that broke off the tooth is removed from the mouth without damaging the tooth enamel thanks to the water and cooling mechanisms used in ultrasonic devices.
Performing Fine Cleaning with a Curette

The stage of performing fine cleaning with a curette, which is one of the final stages of the tartar tooth removal procedure, is a quite important stage. The curette is one of the medical materials referred to as a dental tooth scaler tartar remover among the public, and it especially helps to scrape the tooth tartar that creates pockets in the gum and cannot be cleaned with ultrasonic devices.
Polishing Procedure

In the polishing stage, which is the final stage of tooth tartar removal, a medical procedure is applied to the teeth with a special polish material. Thanks to this procedure, the surfaces that have become rough and excessively matte after the tooth tartar removal are ensured to be both slippery and smooth. The polishing procedure is a quite important and necessary procedure in terms of tooth tartar not forming again in the near future.
Can Tartar Cause Tooth Decay?

Although many people confuse tooth tartar, especially the dark-colored ones, with tooth decays, actually tooth tartar and decay are things different from each other. However, situations like tooth tartar creating a ground for the reproduction of bacteria causing acid production on the tooth and making oral care routines like brushing teeth difficult can cause tooth tartar to lead to big decays in advancing terms.
Can You Remove Tooth Tartar at Home?

You should not perform tooth tartar removal at home. Although many people think they can perform tooth tartar removal at home by buying materials called dental tooth scaler tartar remover sold in mediums like online shopping sites, the situation is actually not like this. It is almost impossible to do the tooth tartar removal at home procedure correctly and completely.

dental tooth scaler tartar removers that can be used at home are generally materials that do not have the necessary features like cooling the tooth by squirting water; because of this, attempting tooth tartar removal at home can lead to severe consequences, including tooth loss while trying to get rid of tooth tartar occurring. On the other hand, since tartar tooth removal is a procedure that must be done delicately by expert dentists, incorrect interventions individuals will do to themselves at home can endanger their general health status as well.
What Happens if tooth tartar is Not Cleaned?
Not cleaning tooth tartar can create a ground for many negative situations to occur. Situations that can be experienced if tartar tooth removal is neglected can be explained under several headings.
Chronic Bad Breath

The formation of chronic bad breath comes at the beginning of the situations that will be experienced if tartar tooth removal is neglected. tooth tartar are bacteria nests, and because of this, there is sulfur production in the regions where tooth tartar is located. These volatile sulfur compounds cause the formation of a smell in the mouth that does not pass and becomes quite disturbing. The bad breath occurring due to tooth tartar becomes chronic as long as you do not get rid of tooth tartar.
Formation of an Unesthetic Appearance

Not cleaning tooth tartar can cause the formation of an unesthetic appearance. Even individuals who have quite white and properly aligned healthy teeth under normal conditions can cause their smile appearance to be disrupted due to tooth tartar because tooth tartar adds a yellowish color to the teeth in the first stage and can cause an appearance as if the teeth are decayed and completely blackened in the subsequent stages.
Occurrence of Gum Diseases

Contrary to what is assumed, tooth tartar accumulates not only on tooth surfaces and between them but also between the tooth and the gum. This accumulation leads to the formation of periodontal pockets in the gums. These periodontal pockets in question, by pushing the gum in a downward direction, can cause gum recession in the first stage and the occurrence of different gum diseases along with it. The loss of gum health can damage both oral health and general health status in the long term.
Tooth Losses

Many individuals who do not have a tooth tartar removal despite needing it for long years can witness their teeth, which are not even decayed, shaking and falling out. The main reason for this situation is that tooth tartar causes great damages to the jawbone and the tissues between the tooth in the long term, leading to the teeth shaking and ultimately falling out.
Increase in Inflammation Throughout the Body

Although it sounds interesting, tooth tartar can cause an increase in inflammation throughout the body and even the damage of various organs of the body. The opening of gum pockets, the mixing of harmful bacteria accumulating in the region into the blood, and the immune system constantly having to fight an infection; can cause an increase in inflammation throughout the body and the general health status progressing in a bad direction.
What Does It Mean When Tartar falling off on Its Own?

Tartar falling off on its own generally points out that the time to have a tooth tartar removal has already come. Although many people think that the teeth are healthily getting rid of tooth tartar and assume this situation is a positive development when they see the tartar chipped off tooth, the situation is actually not like this. In addition to this, tartar falling off on its own is generally a tooth tartar piece breaking off from areas like tooth surfaces, and it is not quite possible for the tooth tartar in the gum pockets to fall off on its own. Due to all these, if your tooth tartar is falling off on its own, you should urgently consult a dentist to have a tooth tartar removal.

As Dentaliva, just as we offer expert support on every subject related to oral and dental health in Istanbul, we also offer comprehensive service on the subject of tooth tartar removal. If you too are suffering from your tooth tartar and want to get rid of this tooth tartar in the most correct way, you can get more information about the subject or request an appointment by contacting us.

The tooth tartar that is broken, shattered, and subsequently, the tartar that broke off the tooth is removed from the mouth without damaging the tooth enamel thanks to the water and cooling mechanisms used in ultrasonic devices.
### Performing Fine Cleaning with a Curette

The stage of performing fine cleaning with a curette, which is one of the final stages of the tartar tooth removal procedure, is a quite important stage. The curette is one of the medical materials referred to as a dental tooth scaler tartar remover among the public, and it especially helps to scrape the tooth tartar that creates pockets in the gum and cannot be cleaned with ultrasonic devices.
### Polishing Procedure

In the polishing stage, which is the final stage of tooth tartar removal, a medical procedure is applied to the teeth with a special polish material. Thanks to this procedure, the surfaces that have become rough and excessively matte after the tooth tartar removal are ensured to be both slippery and smooth. The polishing procedure is a quite important and necessary procedure in terms of tooth tartar not forming again in the near future.
## Can Tartar Cause Tooth Decay?

Although many people confuse tooth tartar, especially the dark-colored ones, with tooth decays, actually tooth tartar and decay are things different from each other. However, situations like tooth tartar creating a ground for the reproduction of bacteria causing acid production on the tooth and making oral care routines like brushing teeth difficult can cause tooth tartar to lead to big decays in advancing terms.
## Can You Remove Tooth Tartar at Home?

You should not perform tooth tartar removal at home. Although many people think they can perform tooth tartar removal at home by buying materials called dental tooth scaler tartar remover sold in mediums like online shopping sites, the situation is actually not like this. It is almost impossible to do the tooth tartar removal at home procedure correctly and completely.

dental tooth scaler tartar removers that can be used at home are generally materials that do not have the necessary features like cooling the tooth by squirting water; because of this, attempting tooth tartar removal at home can lead to severe consequences, including tooth loss while trying to get rid of tooth tartar occurring. On the other hand, since tartar tooth removal is a procedure that must be done delicately by expert dentists, incorrect interventions individuals will do to themselves at home can endanger their general health status as well.
## What Happens if tooth tartar is Not Cleaned?
Not cleaning tooth tartar can create a ground for many negative situations to occur. Situations that can be experienced if tartar tooth removal is neglected can be explained under several headings.
### Chronic Bad Breath

The formation of chronic bad breath comes at the beginning of the situations that will be experienced if tartar tooth removal is neglected. tooth tartar are bacteria nests, and because of this, there is sulfur production in the regions where tooth tartar is located. These volatile sulfur compounds cause the formation of a smell in the mouth that does not pass and becomes quite disturbing. The bad breath occurring due to tooth tartar becomes chronic as long as you do not get rid of tooth tartar.
### Formation of an Unesthetic Appearance

Not cleaning tooth tartar can cause the formation of an unesthetic appearance. Even individuals who have quite white and properly aligned healthy teeth under normal conditions can cause their smile appearance to be disrupted due to tooth tartar because tooth tartar adds a yellowish color to the teeth in the first stage and can cause an appearance as if the teeth are decayed and completely blackened in the subsequent stages.
### Occurrence of Gum Diseases

Contrary to what is assumed, tooth tartar accumulates not only on tooth surfaces and between them but also between the tooth and the gum. This accumulation leads to the formation of periodontal pockets in the gums. These periodontal pockets in question, by pushing the gum in a downward direction, can cause gum recession in the first stage and the occurrence of different gum diseases along with it. The loss of gum health can damage both oral health and general health status in the long term.
### Tooth Losses

Many individuals who do not have a tooth tartar removal despite needing it for long years can witness their teeth, which are not even decayed, shaking and falling out. The main reason for this situation is that tooth tartar causes great damages to the jawbone and the tissues between the tooth in the long term, leading to the teeth shaking and ultimately falling out.
### Increase in Inflammation Throughout the Body

Although it sounds interesting, tooth tartar can cause an increase in inflammation throughout the body and even the damage of various organs of the body. The opening of gum pockets, the mixing of harmful bacteria accumulating in the region into the blood, and the immune system constantly having to fight an infection; can cause an increase in inflammation throughout the body and the general health status progressing in a bad direction.
## What Does It Mean When Tartar falling off on Its Own?

Tartar falling off on its own generally points out that the time to have a tooth tartar removal has already come. Although many people think that the teeth are healthily getting rid of tooth tartar and assume this situation is a positive development when they see the tartar chipped off tooth, the situation is actually not like this. In addition to this, tartar falling off on its own is generally a tooth tartar piece breaking off from areas like tooth surfaces, and it is not quite possible for the tooth tartar in the gum pockets to fall off on its own. Due to all these, if your tooth tartar is falling off on its own, you should urgently consult a dentist to have a tooth tartar removal.

If you too are suffering from your tooth tartar and want to get rid of this tooth tartar in the most correct way, you can get more information about the subject or request an appointment by contacting us.

Flawless Smile Appearance with Digital Smile Design

With digital smile design, you can attain a flawless smile appearance by using modern methods and without harming your general health status. Smile design is one of the important applications in dentistry. It is possible to obtain advantages from many different aspects with the smile design application, which is aimed at correcting the general dental health of individuals and especially improving the aesthetic appearance of their teeth.
What is Digital Smile Design?

Digital smile design is an application in which popular and innovative interventions are performed with the aim of achieving a magnificent smile appearance. Unlike classic aesthetic applications, the appearance to be obtained in smile design is simulated beforehand, and thanks to this simulation, personalized treatment plans are prepared in line with the expert opinions of the dentist, personal demands of individuals, and aesthetic needs. In this application, not only the teeth but also various regions that will affect the smile appearance are intervened in.
How is Design of Smile Done?
Since design of smile is a comprehensive application, it is done by going through several steps. These steps can be handled under a few headings.
1. Preliminary Interview and Comprehensive Examination

Before aesthetic interventions like design of smile, a preliminary interview between the dentist and the individual needs to be performed. In this preliminary interview, while the dentist offers information regarding digital smile design made with digital methods, the patient offers information about personal demands, dental treatments they have seen before, and general health status. This information obtained is consolidated with the data the dentist will obtain as a result of the comprehensive examination to be performed and is used in efficient ways in the subsequent steps.
2. Scanning the Inside of the Mouth and Data Collection

Within the scope of digital smile design, scanning procedures must be performed via intraoral scanners offering 3D imaging. The data obtained as a result of these scanning procedures are collected and converted into images with special software.
3. Simulation with Digital Analysis

One of the most important steps of the digital smile design application is making a simulation with digital analysis. This simulation is performed in a way directed towards what kind of a smile appearance individuals will obtain after the application. Within the scope of digital analysis, the simulation is performed by taking many different factors such as the individuals’ facial features into account. However, in case the individual does not like the resulting appearance, analysis and simulation can be performed again.
What are the Advantages of Digital Smile Design?
Smile design is an application that offers advantages from many different aspects. The advantages of smile design can be explained under a few-item headings.
Performing Interventions Aimed at Improving General Oral Health First

Although the digital smile design application is an application focused on aesthetic purposes, the majority of dentists emphasize that oral health must be in good condition first in order to obtain an aesthetic appearance. Because of this, for individuals who want to benefit from smile design procedures, interventions aimed at improving their general oral health status are performed first. As an example, for a patient who has cavities in their teeth, general oral health is improved by performing procedures like cavity cleaning and filling before the smile design application is performed. This situation enables you to obtain an advantage not only from an aesthetic perspective but also in terms of health.

Allowing the Desired Smile Appearance to be Obtained One of the biggest advantages offered by the digital smile design application is that it allows the desired smile appearance to be obtained. Although the appearance to be obtained in many aesthetic dental applications can be predicted beforehand, it cannot be seen exactly. However, in smile design where the post-procedure appearance is simulated by making analyses before the procedure with special software, the results are not a surprise.

Simulating the results beforehand allows for various arrangements and plans to be made for the sake of obtaining the desired smile appearance. Because of all this, digital smile design provides an advantage to patients who want to have the exact same of the smile appearance they want and want to see the post-application results beforehand.
Performing Intervention Suitable for the Person

The fundamental rule of catching an aesthetic appearance in any body part, including the mouth area, is catching harmony. Performing an aesthetic smile design application for an individual by ignoring factors such as their own facial features, gender, and skin color can lead to obtaining a completely incompatible appearance, contrary to what is thought, not an aesthetic one. However, in smile design, the application is performed not with standard interventions but with interventions suitable for the person.

Especially in health institutions where service is offered with professional dentists like Dentaliva, the design is made by taking many different factors from individuals’ facial features to lip thicknesses into account within the scope of digital smile design. Making such a comprehensive design suitable for the person allows for an aesthetic smile appearance compatible with the individual’s general appearance to be obtained.
The Importance of Smile Design Dentistry

Smile design dentistry is important for many different reasons. Many dentists specialized in their fields look at smile design not as a superficial application offering only the classic white tooth appearance but as a comprehensive intervention that will improve both the individual’s oral health and smile appearance. Because of this, smile design is one of the comprehensive and advantageous applications among smile design dentistry applications.

On the other hand, the fact that experienced dentists can intervene in smile design applications without performing procedures that will harm general oral and dental health, such as abrading the teeth too much, has also ensured that this application is important because it offers an aesthetic appearance without disrupting oral and dental health.
Is Turkey the Best Option for Digital Smile Design?

Turkey is one of the best options for digital smile design. Just as in all healthcare services, it is one of the best countries from a financial and health perspective in the digital smile design application as well. Thanks to professional and reliable health institutions like Dentaliva located in Turkey, you can benefit from affordable smile design suitable for your aesthetic demands and personal needs.
Which Problems Does Digital Smile Design Offer a Solution Against?

Digital smile design is a comprehensive application that can offer a solution against many different problems. The problems that the digital smile design application will offer a solution for can be handled under a few headings.
Gummy Smile Appearance

Gummy smile appearance is the situation where an individual’s gums show more than normal when they smile and the upper part of their teeth remains under the gum. Although some individuals are not disturbed by the gummy smile appearance and even like this appearance, many people are disturbed by the gummy smile appearance. In smile design that steps in at this point, methods like gingivectomy can be resorted to with the aim of eliminating the gummy smile appearance the individual is disturbed by.
Diastema

Diastema is the situation where there is more space than normal between teeth and a gap that is clearly visible. This problem, which is especially seen between the two large front teeth, is a big problem that disrupts the aesthetic appearance for many people. Diastema can stem from many different situations, from the misalignment of teeth to anomalies in the structure of the frenulum. The diastema problem, which can pose a danger not only from an aesthetic perspective but also in terms of health and can affect the speech function, can be solved by resorting to applications like aesthetic composite filling within the scope of digital smile design.
Tooth Yellowing and Tooth Stains

Another problem that the digital smile design application offers a solution for is the changing of tooth color. The changing of tooth color sometimes emerges with the general yellowing of the teeth or the formation of a stain appearance in various regions of the teeth. Tooth yellowing and tooth stains cannot be eliminated with methods like using carbonated mixtures at home, and even oral and dental health can be harmed due to such methods. A white and stainless appearance can be brought to the teeth with whitening or laminate veneer procedures within the scope of digital smile design.

You can attain a magnificent smile appearance with Dentaliva’s digital smile design. By benefiting from digital smile design services performed by experienced dentists in our clinics, you can reach an aesthetic smile appearance suitable for you while also improving your general oral and dental health. What to Expect After Wisdom Tooth Extraction: A Complete Recovery Guide

Some situations and various factors that occur after wisdom tooth extraction cause individuals to be curious about some subjects. Let’s explore the detailed and scientific answers to the questions that come to mind after wisdom tooth extraction, the important details regarding the subject, and the important information that needs to be known regarding the healing process.
What to Eat After Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

After wisdom tooth extraction, first of all, you need to get the doctor’s approval regarding nutrition and have waited long enough. After all these, you need to consume things that are not very hot, very cold, very hard, or grainy. For example, while beverages like hot soup lead to the expansion of the vessels, causing bleeding, grainy and very hard foods can cause destruction in the operation area where the wisdom teeth were extracted. Therefore, you need to consume foods like mashed banana, warm soup, or various fruit purees.
When is the Gauze Removed After Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

When the gauze will be removed after wisdom tooth extraction can show variance depending on the situation. However, in general, it is recommended to wait at least 45 – 50 minutes for the gauze to be removed after wisdom tooth extraction. This period is an important and necessary time for a blood clot to form in the operation areas where the tooth extraction was performed and cavities were formed. Stopping biting the gauze or removing the gauze immediately after the tooth extraction or without waiting for at least 45 minutes to pass can mean facing an intense bleeding that endangers the healing process.
When Can I Drink Alcohol After Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

It is necessary to wait at least 2 – 3 days to drink alcohol after wisdom tooth extraction. The first 24 – 48 hour period after the tooth extraction is the time frame where there is a risk of bleeding and the early healing period of the wound takes place. Drinking alcohol in this time frame means causing bleeding and sabotaging the healing. On the other hand, many patients have to use antibiotic medication against the risk of infection after wisdom tooth extraction. Drinking alcohol during the period when antibiotic medication is used is a quite risky situation. Because of this, it is necessary to wait at least 2 – 3 days to drink alcohol after wisdom tooth extraction and, if antibiotic use is in question, to wait until the medication use is finished.
When Can I Smoke After Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

It is necessary to wait for at least 36 hours, that is, for three days, to smoke after wisdom tooth extraction. Cigarette use causes negative pressure in the mouth and makes healing difficult in various ways. Therefore, it is necessary to stay completely away from cigarettes in the first 3 days after wisdom tooth extraction. Otherwise, you may face bleeding and infections.
Why Do My Other Teeth Ache After Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

The aching of other teeth after wisdom tooth extraction actually generally stems not from extreme situations like the failure of the tooth extraction but from situations considered natural and normal. The nerves to which the wisdom teeth are connected are also connected to other teeth, and because of this, many people feel as if their other teeth are also aching after the tooth extraction. Frequently Asked Questions Before Wisdom Tooth Extraction

There are some things that should and should not be done before wisdom tooth extraction. These things can ensure that individuals become ready for the tooth extraction procedure, the risk of complications occurring during the procedure decreases, and the process is managed in the most controlled way. Especially patients who have worries and questions about wisdom tooth extraction acquiring some important information before the extraction can help them have a healthy and comfortable wisdom tooth extraction treatment period. Come, let’s take a look together at the tips before wisdom tooth extraction and the answers to the frequently asked questions related to the topic.
Is Wisdom Tooth Extraction Necessary?

There are some situations where wisdom tooth extraction is necessary. However, contrary to what is believed, not every individual needs their wisdom teeth to be extracted. Some individuals can use their wisdom teeth in a healthy way or, even if rarely, since some individuals’ wisdom teeth do not exist, their need for wisdom tooth extraction automatically disappears. In summary, the extraction of wisdom teeth is not necessary in every patient and in every situation.

The situations where the extraction of wisdom teeth is necessary are primarily the situations where wisdom teeth remain fully impacted or semi-impacted. Because wisdom teeth remaining fully or semi-impacted can cause the disruption of tooth alignment by applying pressure to other teeth located in the surroundings, the formation of cysts in the jawbone, the occurrence of gingival inflammations, and severe pains, the removal of these teeth is quite important and necessary. Not having the wisdom teeth extracted that are necessary to be extracted can cause not only the wisdom teeth to be damaged in the long term but also the general oral and dental health to be disrupted.
Things to Do Before Wisdom Tooth Extraction
It is necessary to do some important things before wisdom tooth extraction. The important things that need to be done can be handled under several headings.
1. Finding a Reliable Healthcare Institution

As in every kind of medical intervention, the first and most important thing that needs to be done before wisdom tooth extraction is to find a reliable healthcare institution. A reliable healthcare institution takes actions that will prevent you from worrying about subjects like sterilization during tooth extraction procedures. On the other hand, reliable healthcare institutions like Dentaliva take precautions in the name of preventing situations such as the damaging of the nerves in the region from occurring during such procedures by performing the tooth extraction procedures with dentists who are experts in their fields. Due to all these, it is necessary to find a reliable healthcare institution before wisdom tooth extraction.
2. Not Consuming Alcohol and Cigarettes for At Least 24 – 48 Hours

You need to take care not to consume cigarettes and alcohol for at least 24 – 48 hours before wisdom tooth extraction. Consuming alcohol before a complicated medical intervention like a wisdom tooth extraction procedure means dropping the blood clot formation time and the quality of this clot after tooth extraction. Smoking cigarettes, on the other hand, is quite harmful because it shrinks the vessels and negatively affects the transportation of oxygen to the tissues. Due to all these, try to stay away from cigarettes and alcohol for at least 1 – 2 days before having your wisdom teeth extracted.
3. Taking a Break from Blood Thinner Medication Usage by Getting Doctor Approval

Another thing that needs to be done before wisdom tooth extraction is to take a break from blood thinner medication usage. Blood thinner medications are quite important and necessary medications for some individuals with coagulation problems. However, the usage of these medications before medical procedures where blood is needed to clot quickly and healthily, like a wisdom tooth extraction procedure, can put the procedure process and the healing process at risk. Because of this, you must stop using blood thinner medication before tooth extraction. However, you must also not forget that you need to consult your doctor while taking a break from blood thinner medication usage. Otherwise, situations like you not using blood thinners for periods long enough to experience coagulation problems can occur.
4. Paying Attention to General Oral and Dental Health

Many people think that situations like these teeth decaying or holding dental calculus before having their wisdom teeth extracted are unimportant. However, the situation is not actually like this. Even if the wisdom teeth will be extracted, it is necessary to be protected from health problems like tooth decays and dental calculi by paying attention to general oral and dental health because the occurrence of problems like infection in the operation region in question can cause the procedure not to be able to be done or to be done with a high risk rate. Because of this, before wisdom tooth extraction, you need to deeply clean all of your teeth, including the region where your wisdom teeth are located, with materials like a toothbrush and dental floss.
Can I Eat Before a Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

You need to not eat before wisdom tooth extraction. The last meal before wisdom tooth extraction should not be eaten in the 3 – 4 hours before the procedure. It is necessary to not eat for at least 3 – 4 hours before the wisdom tooth extraction procedures that will be performed under local anesthesia. Before the tooth extraction procedures that will be performed under general anesthesia, on the other hand, it is necessary to not eat anything and not drink anything, including water, for at least 8 hours. Otherwise, the operation and anesthesia process can get under risk.
Can Wisdom Tooth Extraction Be Done Under General Anesthesia?

Wisdom tooth extraction can be done under general anesthesia. before wisdom tooth extraction, some patients can request the application of general anesthesia because they feel very worried about the procedure and are very afraid of suffering pain. On the other hand, patients whose wisdom teeth are very strong or who will not be able to remain stable throughout the operation due to the gag reflex may also need to benefit from general anesthesia. In such situations, by keeping factors like the individual’s general health status in view, it can be decided to do tooth extraction with general anesthesia application.

Especially equipped healthcare institutions like Dentaliva, because they also meet the requirements on the subject of general anesthesia, can ensure the successful completion of tooth extraction procedures done under general anesthesia with anesthesia specialists who are experts in their fields.
Is a Blood Test Done Before Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

It may be necessary for a blood test to be done before wisdom tooth extraction. It is possible for patients who will not have more than one wisdom tooth extracted and whose general health status is in a good state to benefit from wisdom tooth extraction without a blood test being done. However, individuals who will have more than one wisdom tooth extracted and who have chronic health problems like diabetes need to have blood tests like coagulation tests done before the tooth extraction procedures. These blood tests are very important in terms of determining a tooth extraction date suitable for the individual and dropping the probability of complications occurring.
Is Antibiotic Used Before Wisdom Tooth Extraction?

Antibiotic can be used before wisdom tooth extraction. Patients who use antibiotics due to various health problems do not need to take a break from antibiotic usage for wisdom tooth extraction. On the other hand, antibiotic usage before wisdom tooth extraction becomes necessary for patients facing problems like gingival inflammation because surgical intervention cannot be made to a region where infection is found.

If you want to get support from a professional and reliable healthcare institution before wisdom tooth extraction, you can prefer Dentaliva. As Dentaliva, we offer reliable service with our professional dentists in wisdom tooth extractions just as in every subject related to oral and dental health. You too can contact us to benefit from these services and get more information about wisdom tooth treatment.

What are the Dental Implant Types?
Dental implant types are implant varieties that appeal to different patient profiles. The implant varieties in question can be handled under a few headings.
Single Implants

Even if many people do not know it, implant treatment can be performed against a single tooth loss. Some individuals may lose a single tooth as a result of traumas or various oral health problems. This single tooth loss is a problem large enough not to be ignored because it can cause problems such as a decrease in jawbone density, deterioration of the alignment of other teeth, and aesthetic appearance problems to occur. Single implants, which eliminate tooth loss by offering an effective and permanent solution against single tooth loss, can be used for long periods or for a lifetime with durable dental prostheses.
All On Four Implant

All on four dental implants offer effective treatment for individuals who have lost a large portion of their teeth. As can be understood from its name, in this treatment method performed with the attachment of 4 artificial tooth roots, namely implants, a prosthesis containing more than one artificial tooth is placed on the quadruple artificial tooth root in question. In this way, the multiple tooth losses of individuals are eliminated and an effective solution is offered. The biggest advantage of All on four treatment is that it can also appeal to patient profiles who have not been able to completely protect their jawbone density but want to eliminate multiple tooth loss.
All On Six Implant

All on six dental implants also have a structure similar to all on four implants. However, as can be understood from its name, since 6 artificial tooth roots, namely implants, are used in all on six implants, it allows an effective solution to be offered even to individuals who have lost all of their teeth. The all on six option is especially aimed at patient profiles who lose all of their teeth but do not lose their jawbone density and want to obtain very effective results.

To benefit from implant treatment, general health status must be good, jawbone density must be protected at least partially, and the individual must not have chronic health problems such as advanced diabetes.

In addition to this, in case individuals meet all criteria but do not meet the jawbone density criterion, implant treatment can also be performed for these individuals thanks to applications aimed at increasing jawbone density.
How Does the Dental Implant Turkey Treatment Process Progress?
The dental implant Turkey treatment process progresses by going through several steps. The steps in question can be explained in a few items.

First, comprehensive examinations are performed and imaging techniques are utilized to have information about subjects such as the individual’s jawbone density, alignment of teeth if any, and general oral health.
A personalized treatment plan is prepared in line with the information obtained from imaging techniques, examinations, and the individual’s own opinions.

By applying local anesthesia, implants, which are artificial tooth roots, are placed into the jawbone. After this step, temporary dental prostheses are generally attached to the individual and the implants are expected to fuse to the jawbone.
After the implants and the jawbone fuse to each other, permanent dental prostheses are placed on the implants in question via bonding materials and the treatment process is completed.

Factors That Can Damage Braces

Braces are the most common orthodontic treatment to straighten teeth and bite properly. It is also important for your teeth to look straight for a healthy-looking smile. This is also possible with the help of braces. Because crooked teeth can prevent a person from smiling in social life and from showing his teeth. However, this treatment includes some factors that patients should pay attention to. Being aware of these factors that can damage braces is essential to ensure successful and effective treatment. Braces are an effective orthodontic treatment method used to solve dental problems that require straightening. However, braces can be damaged if proper care and attention is not given. Factors that damage brackets and wires are as follows. Knowing these situations at the beginning of the treatment helps prevent damage to the braces.
Hard and Sticky Foods

Hard and sticky foods can damage your braces. Snacks such as chips, hard candies, gum and nuts can damage the wires. Such foods can cause the wires to break or split. Therefore, such foods should be avoided during the treatment period to protect your teeth and braces. Harmful effects of hard foods on braces may be as follows:
Hard foods can cause braces to break. This may prolong the treatment process and cause extra costs.

Sticky and hard foods may cause the position of the wires to change. In other words, the adjustment made by the orthodontist on the braces may be disrupted. This may prolong the treatment process and prevent successful results.
Hard foods can cause aches and pains. This may cause patients to feel uncomfortable and avoid eating.
Chewing gum can cause your braces to become misaligned.
These foods may contain sugar and acid, which can lead to tooth decay. This can threaten dental health and make the treatment process more complicated.
Some precautions you can take to prevent hard foods from damaging your braces are:
Avoid hard foods or consume them in small food particles.
Make sure to eat soft and healthy foods after wearing your braces, so that you do not put too much pressure on your braces.
Clean braces regularly and follow your dentist’s recommended care instructions.
Poor Oral Hygiene

Braces are places where food particles and plaque build up easily. Poor oral hygiene can lead to tooth decay, gum problems, and stains on teeth and braces. It is necessary to ensure cleanliness between the wires by brushing your teeth, flossing and using mouthwash regularly.
Inadequate oral hygiene can have negative effects on braces and prolong the treatment process. Here is some information about how poor oral hygiene affects braces:

Plaque Buildup: Braces are designed to prevent the buildup of food particles and bacteria. However, inadequate oral hygiene may cause this accumulation to increase. Plaque accumulation can lead to tooth decay and gum problems.
Gum problems: Inadequate hygiene can lead to gum swelling, bleeding and gingivitis. This can cause discomfort and pain around the braces.
Stains and Color Changes: Inadequate oral hygiene can cause teeth staining and color changes. This can make it difficult to achieve the same color when the braces are removed.
Tooth Decay: Braces contain areas where food particles and plaque buildup can easily become trapped. Inadequate oral hygiene can cause tooth decay in these areas.
Prolongation of the Treatment Process: Problems arising from inadequate oral hygiene may prolong the treatment process. Straightening braces and achieving results may require more time and effort.

For the above reasons, it is extremely important to have a regular and effective oral hygiene routine after getting braces. Follow your dentist’s recommended brushing, flossing, and mouthwash instructions to clean the areas around your braces and keep your teeth in good condition. Additionally, regular dentist visits are important to check the health of your braces and the treatment process.
Teeth Grinding or Clenching

Braces can wear or break due to constant clenching or grinding of teeth. These habits can compromise the success of treatment and prolong treatment time. If there is a problem with the brackets or wires, it is important to consult an orthodontist immediately.
Loosening or Movement of Braces

Clenching the teeth may cause the braces to loosen or move. Braces are placed in a specific way to straighten teeth, and these positions must be maintained. Otherwise, it may cause the straightened teeth to return to their previous positions.
Braces Breakage

Clenching your teeth can cause braces to break. This means the cables may need to be replaced or repaired. This may prolong the treatment process and increase costs. You can contact us for a beautiful smile aesthetics.
Pain and Discomfort
Clenching teeth can cause pain and discomfort in the mouth and jaw area. This may cause the treatment process to be more uncomfortable and difficult.
Tooth Decay
Clenching teeth can cause teeth to rub against each other. This can cause tooth decay or cause this negative condition to progress because cleaning between the teeth becomes more difficult.
Pressure
Clenching your teeth puts extra pressure on the braces. This can cause the strings to be tighter on it.
Not Using Mouth Guard During Sports

If you are actively involved in sports and wear braces, it is important to wear a mouth guard. Impacts to the teeth during sports can damage the braces. Wearing a mouth guard helps protect your teeth and braces.
Going to Check-ups Irregularly:

You should visit the dentist regularly throughout the treatment process. The dentist can evaluate the condition of the wires, make adjustments and detect problems when necessary. Regular check-ups are the key to successful treatment.
Hurt of Brackets and Wires:

Brackets and wires can sometimes be accidentally injured or broken. Such situations can delay the straightening of the teeth and cause discomfort. In case of strains or fractures, you should see an orthodontist immediately.

In conclusion, braces are a very effective treatment method for solving dental problems. However, paying attention to factors that may damage braces ensures successful progress and outcome of the treatment. Oral hygiene, diet, sports activities and regular medical check-ups are important to protect braces. If any problems occur, it would be best to see an orthodontist.
Contact us and make an appointment for our orthodontics and other dental treatments. Our dentists and orthodontists will do their best to help you have healthy teeth.

Bleeding Gums: Causes & Treatment

Bleeding gums are a symptom of diseases that occur primarily in the gums. However, apart from gum diseases, the underlying cause may also be other health problems. Harsh tooth brushing, incorrect use of dental floss, and mistakes in using dentures can cause bleeding in the gums. In addition to routine daily problems, bleeding gums may also indicate chronic conditions such as diabetes, hemophilia, and low platelet count in the blood.

Gums or also known as gingiva; It is a mucosa tissue that surrounds the teeth and acts as a protective barrier. It helps grind food by settling firmly into the bone tissues it surrounds. It prevents food residues from passing into the periodontal areas. The color of the gums is coral pink in healthy individuals.

Gums have a tissue rich in blood vessels. If the vessels in the gum tissue are damaged due to internal and external factors, people experience bleeding gums. The most common cause of bleeding gums is excessive plaque accumulated in the gums. The sticky bacterial plaque called gingivitis that occurs after this accumulation causes inflammation in the gums. These plaques cause bleeding in the gums. Excessive plaque accumulation can lead to bleeding as well as a jaw bone condition called periodontitis. These disorders negatively affect people’s oral health. The treatment of this disorder, which negatively affects the person’s health and may have different sub-causes, should be started as soon as possible under the supervision of a dentist.
What are the Causes of Bleeding Gums?

The most important cause of gum bleeding is inadequate oral hygiene and gingivitis inflammation. Chronic diseases or vitamin deficiencies should be examined in case of constantly recurring gum bleeding. The most necessary thing to prevent bleeding gums is to learn the causes of this problem thoroughly.
Physical Trauma: Hard and shelly foods consumed by patients or external damage to the tooth structure may cause gum bleeding.
Intraoral Prosthesis: People using dentures or oral prostheses that do not fit their mouth structure can damage teeth and gums and cause gum bleeding.
Pregnancy: Hormonal changes during pregnancy cause edema in the gums or excessive blood flow to the gum area. Pregnant women may experience bleeding gums due to these changes in hormones.
Chronic Diseases: Chronic diseases that damage the gums, such as diabetes, blood clotting problem (hemophilia), decrease in the number of platelets in the blood, can cause gum bleeding.

Vitamin deficiencies; Vitamins C and K are very important for the health of gum tissues. Vitamin C is indispensable for the connecting tissues surrounding the teeth and jaw bones. Vitamin C contributes to the development of tissues in the body and accelerates the healing of tissue wounds. Vitamin K deficiency causes problems in blood clotting, which can cause bleeding disorders. As a result of people taking insufficient vitamins C and K, their gums may be affected by vitamin deficiency. Therefore, foods rich in vitamins C and K should be consumed.

Bleeding gums while brushing teeth is the most common symptom experienced by people. When a person thinks that he or she is experiencing gum bleeding for no reason, there is actually an underlying reason. This may be due to harsh use of dental floss and toothbrush or bad nutrition habits.
Factors Related to Oral Hygiene
One of the frequently seen factors that causes bleeding gums is oral hygiene.

Oral Hygiene Habit: Failure to perform oral and dental care regularly and with tools suitable for the tooth structure, or neglecting it, may damage the gums. If you do not brush your teeth regularly, your oral hygiene is poor.

Dental Health and Oral Care During Pregnancy

Individuals who regularly maintain their dental and gum health and attend routine check-ups before pregnancy, as well as expectant mothers who do not have any oral health issues, can benefit from the advantages of paying attention to oral and dental care during pregnancy. Therefore, they are less likely to face any dental problems during pregnancy. However, in some cases, hormonal changes may cause swelling and bleeding in the gums and teeth.

The dental treatment process during pregnancy is not significantly different from the treatment process outside of pregnancy. For this reason, the period between the 4th and 7th months of pregnancy is considered the most suitable time for protecting oral and dental health and performing dental treatments. During the first and last three months of pregnancy, treatment can be provided for urgent dental issues. However, it is important to know that appropriate treatment methods can be applied at any stage of pregnancy. What truly matters is whether the expectant mother has any underlying health problems during pregnancy. Therefore, it is highly recommended that the pregnant woman consult her obstetrician and obtain information about her general health status before beginning any dental treatment.
Why Is Oral and Dental Care Important During Pregnancy?

In pregnant women with ineffective oral care and resulting gum bleeding, the development of pregnancy-related gum tumors is often inevitable. Furthermore, if expectant mothers at risk of miscarriage have poor oral hygiene, this risk may increase further. Increased hormonal changes can cause sensitivity in the gums, making them more prone to gum disease. Due to vomiting and nausea, oral care may be neglected during pregnancy, and the increase in oral acidity related to pregnancy may become a major cause of increased tooth decay during this sensitive time. However, tooth loss caused by gum inflammation and gum disease during pregnancy is not the fault of the baby in the womb, but rather the result of the mother’s insufficient oral and dental care during this period.

Dental anesthesia can be safely administered during pregnancy as long as the patient has no allergies and the pregnancy is progressing without complications. To avoid unexpected tooth loss due to dental or gum problems during pregnancy, there are some essential precautions expectant mothers must take. One of the most important steps is for a woman who is planning pregnancy to visit the dentist beforehand and have any potential dental problems treated. Worn bridges, decayed teeth, dentures, impacted teeth, and tartar buildup that invites gum disease may all lead to oral and dental problems during pregnancy. If these issues progress, tooth loss becomes inevitable, so even the smallest concerns should be addressed during this period.

Even if the pregnancy is unplanned, it is still beneficial to visit a dentist for tartar cleaning to prevent dental and gum diseases. It is also very important to follow the dentist’s recommendations for oral hygiene and to continue with regular dental check-ups. Along with paying attention to oral care, adopting a healthy diet during pregnancy is also essential. Avoiding frequent consumption of foods that can cause tooth decay is crucial. Therefore, pregnant women should brush their teeth at least twice a day to maintain oral hygiene. Daily flossing and rinsing with warm salt water are also very helpful.

Maintaining a healthy diet during pregnancy is vital for both the mother’s and baby’s health. A baby’s tooth development begins in the early months of pregnancy. Babies receive phosphorus, vitamins, and calcium from their mothers to support healthy dental development, so this should be considered as well.

The first 3–6 months of pregnancy are considered the most suitable period for dental treatment. If anesthesia is required for treatment during this time, it is generally safe to proceed. If an X-ray is absolutely necessary, the expectant mother must wear a lead apron. The dental treatment process during pregnancy is no different from treatment at any other time. Light bleeding during tooth brushing is considered normal during pregnancy, but excessive bleeding may indicate pregnancy gingivitis. Therefore, it is important to visit the dentist for proper examination and tartar cleaning. Healthy teeth and gums should not bleed, so understanding this can help expectant mothers take the right precautions to protect both their own and their baby’s health.

An increase in tooth decay during pregnancy is often inevitable. However, it is incorrect to assume that the baby takes calcium from the mother’s teeth, as this is a misconception. Frequent consumption of sugary foods, poor brushing habits, and neglecting oral care during the postpartum period are more likely causes. The most important step an expectant mother can take—both before and during pregnancy—is to regularly visit the dentist and receive necessary treatments without delay.
Effective Oral and Dental Care During Pregnancy

It is a common belief that during pregnancy, the baby draws calcium from the mother’s teeth, leading to tooth loss. However, this belief is not accurate. While some expectant mothers experience dental and gum problems during pregnancy, many assume these issues are caused solely by pregnancy. In reality, paying attention to a few simple details can be enough for a pregnant woman to maintain her oral and dental health. One of the most important factors is consuming calcium-rich foods regularly and correctly.

To maintain oral and dental health throughout pregnancy, it is essential to have a balanced intake of key nutrients rich in vitamins A, C, and D, as well as calcium and phosphorus. This includes whole grains, dairy products, fruits and vegetables, fish, meat, and eggs. It is recommended that pregnant women consume 1200–1500 mg of calcium daily to support the bone health of both mother and baby. Therefore, calcium-rich foods like milk and dairy products, and leafy green vegetables should be a staple in a pregnant woman’s diet.

A baby’s tooth development begins in the womb, and around the 5th or 6th week of pregnancy, the process starts to strengthen. Thus, the expectant mother should pay special attention to a balanced diet for the dental health of both herself and her baby. If the mother maintains a proper diet and consistently follows an oral hygiene routine, the likelihood of facing any unusual dental problems during pregnancy is very low.

During pregnancy, an increase in acidity in the mother’s saliva makes the teeth more susceptible to decay. Vomiting, especially in early pregnancy, can further increase the risk of cavities if proper oral hygiene is neglected. To prevent this, pregnant women with gum issues must be extra careful with their oral hygiene. Otherwise, hormonal changes in the body can trigger gum problems. Expectant mothers who experience constant gum bleeding may avoid brushing their teeth due to discomfort. However, unbrushed teeth lead to more bacterial buildup, gum swelling, increased bleeding, and redness.
What Should Be Done for Oral and Dental Care During Pregnancy?
To maintain oral and dental health during pregnancy, regular care is essential. Following the steps below can help expectant mothers keep their teeth healthy throughout this period:
After consuming sweets, pregnant women should brush their teeth after a short period.
Following episodes of vomiting or nausea, oral hygiene should be performed—at the very least, the mouth should be rinsed thoroughly.
Tooth brushing should not be delayed to avoid gum bleeding.
Brushing at least twice a day and using dental floss helps provide effective oral care and prevents plaque buildup.
Mouthwash suitable for pregnant women or warm salt water rinses should be used. Warm salt water, in particular, soothes the gums and helps reduce gum sensitivity.
A calcium-rich diet should be prioritized.
Unless absolutely necessary, dental X-rays during pregnancy should be postponed until after childbirth.

Extensive dental treatments should be avoided during the first trimester. Planned treatments should be scheduled for the second trimester—between the 4th and 6th months. During the last trimester, which is considered more critical, treatments should be postponed unless they are urgent.
The use of antibiotics or painkillers during pregnancy should always be based on a doctor’s recommendation.
Local anesthesia can be safely administered during pregnancy unless there is a specific contraindication. However, it is always best to first consult an obstetrician.

Maintaining oral and dental health before, during, and after pregnancy requires consistent and thorough cleaning. Additionally, choosing a dental clinic that provides high-standard services is crucial. With many years of experience, Dentaliva continues to provide all types of dental services in a trustworthy, high-quality, and welcoming environment. Known for its reliable service and outstanding care, Dentaliva helps you achieve a clean, radiant smile and healthy teeth.
